claims.statement: Every finite disjoint tensor product of Boolean point defects, with arbitrary component dimensions and multiplicities, satisfies H<4I and U<3I. For one d-dimensional point defect, U=(1-2delta)^2 log2(1/(1-2delta)^2)+2d delta(1-2delta), delta=2^-d, and U/I tends to 1.
claims.quantifiers: Every finite multiset of integers d_j>=1; point defects on pairwise disjoint uniform physical cubes.
proof_dependencies: Exact Walsh transform of a Boolean point defect
A077 sequence definition at source-pinned version
claims.limitations: Does not cover overlapping nonlinear surgeries or non-point-defect gates; does not prove full FEI.
